an7.29:1.1: XXVII. Satt' ime bhikkhave dhammā upāsakassa parihānāya saṃvattanti. Katame satta? Bhikkhudassanaṃ hāpeti, saddhammasavanaṃ pamajjati, adhisīle na sikkhati, appasādabahulo hoti bhikkhūsu theresu c' eva navesu ca majjhimesu ca, upārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, ito bahiddhā dakkhineyyaṃ gavesati, tattha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti. Ime kho bhikkhave satta dhammā upāsakassa parihānāya saṃvattanti.
an7.29:2.1: Satt' ime bhikkhave dhammā upāsakassa aparihānāya saṃvattanti. Katame satta? Bhikkhudassanaṃ na hāpeti, saddhammasavanaṃ na ppamajjati, adhisīle sikkhati, pasādabahulo hoti bhikkhūsu theresu c' eva navesu ca majjhimesu ca, anupārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti na randhagavesī, na ito bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, idha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti. Ime kho bhikkhave satta dhammā upāsakassa aparihānāya saṃvattantī ti. Dassanaṃ bhāvitattānaṃ
an7.29:3.1: yo hāpeti upāsako savanañ ca ariyadhammānaṃ adhisīle na sikkhati
an7.29:4.1: appasādo ca bhikkhūsu bhīyo bhīyo pavaḍḍhati upārambhakacitto ca saddhammaṃ sotum icchati
an7.29:5.1: ito ca bahiddhā aññaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati tatth' eva ca pubbakāraṃ yo karoti upāsako:
an7.29:6.1: ete kho parihānīye satta dhamme sudesite upāsako sevamāno saddhammā parihāyati.
an7.29:7.1: Dassanaṃ bhāvitattānaṃ yo na hāpeti upāsako savanañ ca ariyadhammānaṃ adhisīle ca sikkhati
an7.29:8.1: pasādo c' assa bhikkhūsu bhīyo bhīyo pavaḍḍhati anupārambhacitto ca saddhammaṃ sotum icchati
an7.29:9.1: na ito bahiddhā aññaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati idh' eva ca pubbakāraṃ yo karoti upāsako:
an7.29:10.1: ete kho aparihānīye satta dhamme sudesite upāsako sevamāno saddhammā na parihāyatī ti. XXVIII-XXX.
